description: The Branch Manager leads all branch operations, branch staff and customer service at the branch.
The Customer Service Officer handles customer enquiries, complaints and service requests.
The Sales Executive acquires new customers and sells deposit and card products.
The HR Executive supports recruitment, onboarding, employee records and exits.
The Finance Associate processes payments, reconciliations and month-end reporting.
The Operations Coordinator oversees branch back-office processing and vault operations.
The IT Support Engineer resolves hardware, software and access issues for bank staff.
The Compliance Officer monitors adherence to regulatory requirements and internal policies.
The Marketing Executive plans and runs marketing campaigns across digital and branch channels.
The Data Analyst prepares dashboards, reports and analysis for management decisions.
The Cash Teller handles cash deposits, withdrawals and counter transactions.
The Team Leader supervises a team of 5 to 10 staff in operations or customer service.
